title: The Needle Toll
description: A ring of bent needles bars the path, each one threaded with a single bright scrap. The toll-keeper's stitches pull tight as you step closer.

choices.text: Pay the Needle Toll: one living hero with at least 7 HP loses 6 HP (never torn), then choose one of two rare cards.
Step back from the needles and pocket the loose scrap (+1 scrap).
